selection_rule: Retain the existing paper-facing seed 7 and add four precommitted distinct prime seeds before any new multi-seed outcome access.
execution_scope: Run the full model and every paper-facing ablation/control under identical data splits, budgets, and evaluation code for every frozen seed.
integrity_rules: Do not substitute, add, or remove seeds after outcome access.
Do not lower the rigor gate minimum seed requirement.
Regenerate results/final_rigor/metrics.json only from the complete frozen seed set.
Do not claim robustness or submission readiness unless scripts/check_rigor_gate.py returns RIGOR_GATE_PASS on the complete aggregate.
